title: Guard Core: Whitespace-collapse preprocessing permanently disables the CRLF-anchored http-splitting and…
description: Guard-core versions prior to 3.13.0 in enhanced detection mode preprocess input by collapsing all whitespace, including CR and LF characters, before pattern matching. This preprocessing removes the CRLF characters required by two built-in detectors (http_split and cmd_injection), causing them to miss payloads that include CRLF sequences. As a result, HTTP response splitting and newline-anchored command injection payloads evade detection, although other attack types remain detected. The issue is fixed in version 3.13.0 by preserving CRLF during whitespace collapse or adjusting detection to run on preprocessed content.
